info.name: Sonarfy - Album details
info.description: Authenticated album details contract: docs/api/albums.md. Set baseUrl, accessToken and albumSpotifyId locally. Reading an unknown album may persist catalog metadata. No review writes. Provider failures are exercised by the integration tests against the versioned Postman simulation. Community requests verify public authors, all four sorts, keyset pagination when available, input validation and authentication. Empty and populated scenarios run against real HTTP in AlbumDetailsPostgresTest.

item.name: Search albums without personal Spotify connection

exec: pm.test('Search page contract', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.all.keys('items','limit','offset','nextOffset'); pm.expect(b.limit).to.eql(2); pm.expect(b.offset).to.eql(0); pm.expect(b.items.length).to.be.at.most(2); for (const a of b.items) { pm.expect(a).to.have.all.keys('spotifyId','name','coverUrl','artist','releaseOn','releasePrecision','totalTracks'); pm.expect(a.spotifyId).to.match(/^[A-Za-z0-9]{22}$/); pm.expect(a.artist).to.have.all.keys('spotifyId','name'); } });

pm.test('Public album contract', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.all.keys('spotifyId','name','coverUrl','artist','releaseOn','releasePrecision','totalTracks','averageRating','reviewCount'); pm.expect(b.spotifyId).to.eql(pm.variables.get('albumSpotifyId')); pm.expect(b.artist).to.have.all.keys('spotifyId','name'); pm.expect(b.totalTracks).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(b.reviewCount).to.be.at.least(0); if (b.reviewCount === 0) pm.expect(b.averageRating).to.eql(null); else { pm.expect(b.averageRating).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(b.averageRating).to.be.at.most(10); } });

pm.test('Community contract', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.all.keys('items','nextCursor'); pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(b.items.length).to.be.at.most(2); for (const r of b.items) { pm.expect(r).to.have.all.keys('reviewId','author','rating','reviewText','createdAt','updatedAt'); pm.expect(r.author).to.have.all.keys('id','handle','displayName','avatarUrl'); pm.expect(r.rating).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(r.rating).to.be.at.most(10); } });
const b = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('communityCursor', b.nextCursor || ''); pm.collectionVariables.set('communityIds', JSON.stringify(b.items.map(r => r.reviewId)));

item.name: Read next community page when available

exec: pm.test('Community contract', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.all.keys('items','nextCursor'); pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(b.items.length).to.be.at.most(2); for (const r of b.items) { pm.expect(r).to.have.all.keys('reviewId','author','rating','reviewText','createdAt','updatedAt'); pm.expect(r.author).to.have.all.keys('id','handle','displayName','avatarUrl'); pm.expect(r.rating).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(r.rating).to.be.at.most(10); } });

pm.test('No repeated reviews', () => { const previous = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('communityIds') || '[]'); for (const r of pm.response.json().items) pm.expect(previous).not.to.include(r.reviewId); });
